WITH RECURSIVE category_hierarchy (id, name, parentId) AS (
SELECT id, name, parent_id AS parentId FROM category WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id AS parentId FROM category c INNER JOIN category_hierarchy ch ON c.parent_id = ch.id )
SELECT * FROM category_hierarchy;

SELECT a.id , a.name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , a.parent_id , b.name AS created_by_Name , c.name AS modified_by_Name FROM category a LEFT JOIN MEMBER b ON a.created_by = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.modified_by = c.id WHERE UPPER(a.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR UPPER(a.id) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%')

SELECT a.id , a.name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , a.parent_id , b.name AS created_by_Name , c.name AS modified_by_Name FROM category a LEFT JOIN MEMBER b ON a.created_by = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.modified_by = c.id WHERE UPPER(a.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{categoryName}), '%')

SELECT a.id , a.name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , a.parent_id , b.name AS created_by_Name , c.name AS modified_by_Name FROM category a LEFT JOIN MEMBER b ON a.created_by = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.modified_by = c.id WHERE a.id = #{categoryId}

SELECT a.id , a.name , a.created_at , a.modified_at , a.parent_id , b.name AS created_by_Name , c.name AS modified_by_Name FROM category a LEFT JOIN MEMBER b ON a.created_by = b.id LEFT JOIN MEMBER c ON a.modified_by = c.id
